# Patchwork's Plastering Company

> An owner-operated stucco and plaster repair contractor in Garden Grove, CA, serving Orange County since 1997. Owner: Aston C. Hill. CSLB C-35 Lathing & Plastering #737480. Specializes in small-to-medium patches with matched textures. It bids from photos: email aston.patchworks@yahoo.com or call (714) 530-5119.
